landingSubtitle: A production-ready Next.js 15 enterprise starter engineered with 3 layout archetypes, Firebase authentication, responsive containment, and internationalization.
archetypesSubtitle: Every page in this application maps directly to one of three purposeful layout archetypes via the PageContainer abstraction.
archetype1Desc: Constrained reading container optimized for readability, user preferences, account security, and billing configurations.
archetype1Features: Centered layout • Section Eyebrows • Stacked Cards • Danger Zone
archetype2Desc: Full-width fluid operational canvas engineered for high-density dashboards, interactive charts, and multi-column split tools.
archetype2Features: KPI Stat Grids • Recharts Visualizations • Tabbed Data Tables • Split Workspace
archetype3Desc: Viewport-locked, zero-scroll infinite canvas with pan & zoom, draggable node cards, and animated bezier connectors.
archetype3Features: Pan/Zoom Transform • Collapsible Side Drawers • SVG DAG Flow • Telemetry & Minimap
architectureTitle: How the Demo Pages Are Setup
architectureSubtitle: Engineered for speed, developer ergonomics, and rock-solid architectural boundaries.
archRoutingDesc: Next.js App Router with i18n locale grouping [locale]/(app). All inner views are protected by ProtectedRoute with Firebase Auth session management.
archNavbarDesc: Zero prop-drilling header integration. Pages mount contextual breadcrumbs and execution action buttons directly into TopNavbar via React context.
archDesignDesc: Pure semantic CSS variable tokens (bg-card, border-border, bg-accent, bg-primary) with seamless light/dark mode and hotkey D toggle.
archI18nDesc: Full next-intl localization supporting English and Simplified Chinese with localized routing and instant language switching.
quickstartTitle: Build Your Next Feature in 4 Steps
quickstartSubtitle: Follow these standard conventions to add a new page with zero layout debt:
step1Desc: Choose settings, workspace, or canvas based on page density and interaction needs.
step2Desc: Create app/[locale]/(app)/[feature]/page.tsx with your React component.
step3Desc: Wrap your root layout with PageContainer variant="...".
step4Desc: Add your route to components/app-sidebar.tsx and breadcrumb mapping in components/top-navbar.tsx.
